propositions: Three separate detached-child spawn sites independently re-implement the same pattern (PYTHONPATH bootstrap, -c re-entry stub, platform detach flags, stdio discipline, cwd handling), creating maintenance burden and risk of propagated defects
A missing cwd argument bug present in all three spawn sites propagated through deliberate copy-paste across multiple tickets because no single canonical implementation existed

Consolidate all detached rebar child spawning behind one helper function spawn_detached in _proc.py that owns PYTHONPATH bootstrap, detach flags, and durable cwd while preserving per-caller exception handling and env construction

A static source scan test must enforce that the detached spawn signature (DETACHED_PROCESS/CREATE_NO_WINDOW tokens and sys.path.insert re-entry stub) appears only in _proc.py to prevent future copy-paste propagation
_proc.py must remain a stdlib-only leaf with no rebar.* imports and the helper must re-raise on failure with per-caller exception handling and logging preserved
